lines.text: Hi, this is Maria Lopez, a licensed agent with Harborline Insurance. Before we continue, I need to let you know this call is recorded for quality and compliance purposes.
Thank you. You filled out a form online about health coverage. Do I have your permission to ask a few questions about your household and go over plan options with you today?
Great. Do you currently have any health coverage?
No, I lost my employer plan last month.
I'm sorry to hear that. How many people would be on the plan, and is there a monthly budget you're trying to stay under?
Just me and my daughter. Ideally under four hundred a month.
Understood. Are there any doctors or prescriptions you want to keep?
My daughter sees a pediatrician at Lakeside Clinic, and I take one blood pressure medication.

Thanks. I'll check which plans have Lakeside Clinic in network and cover your medication. I can't promise a specific price until the application is reviewed, but I'll show you the estimated premiums and deductibles side by side.
I'll email you a comparison of three plans within the hour, and I'll call you back tomorrow at two p.m. to go through them. Does that time work?
Perfect. Thank you for your time, and talk to you tomorrow.
